_comment: The NEGATIVE corpus (must-REJECT programs; VERSION_TEST_MATRIX_DESIGN P2.8/Phase-2): each enabled entry is <name>.cob + <name>.err (the expected diagnostic substring, e.g. an edition-band code) + an "editions" map naming the --std values that must reject. Seeding: >=1 case per Wave-1 gate + the reserved-word interval witnesses (roadmap Phase 2 W2). The matrix reject cells already pin gate diagnostics; THIS corpus holds the free-form adversarial cases.
